items.title: Joe Harris Interview, 1961-04-12
items.q: I think he learned in Lutche, Louisiana on the, I think it was Professor Holmes. ... Well, he was teaching all the musicians.

ctx.x: Do you know, did your father ever tell you where he learned or when he learned and who's, if he had a teacher or anything about his early days? No, he did.

I think he learned in Lutche, Louisiana on the, I think it was Professor Holmes. Professor Holmes. Professor Holmes up there in Lutche. In Lutche, yes. Well, he was teaching all the musicians. A little country town in there, he was teaching all the musicians. He's still there? No, he's dead now. Oh, Professor Holmes. My father's dead too.

And let's see, this picture here, this band is, is that one that you were in or your father? No, my father. That's my father here. Oh, the one sitting in the middle of the sax, alto sax. Yeah, and the clarinet. That's my father. And the clarinet. Yes, I see he has the clarinet standing there. I can't see the picture, it's a little bit dim. Did he play Albert System or Bane System? I think that was a C.G.
